notes.title: GWD "Future Ideas" Discussion
notes.content:
Hi All!

I just wanted to let you know I have created a new discussion where you can post ideas you have for future updates!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/786120/discussions/0/1698294337781989029/

Thanks
- Christopher P.
